title: Dockerfile RIFE prebake still pulls from huggingface.co on a claim that is now false
description: Requested by the MPI-491 session at close-out, verified 2026-08-08. The image build prebakes RIFE weights from huggingface.co on the strength of a comment at Dockerfile:348 calling marduk191/rife 'a plain non-Xet repo, never 403s'. That is STALE: every HF path now 302s to us.aws.cdn.hf.co/xet-bridge-us, rife included, and MPI-148 is on record that this CDN 403s ranged aria2 NON-DETERMINISTICALLY and broke the whole docker build when it did. So the build carries a flake whose justification no longer holds. docs/runpod-troubleshooting.md is already corrected (9be9dfc3); the Dockerfile is not. NOT a 1.4 gate - it is an image-build risk, never user-facing, and it only bites when a build happens to hit a 403. Fix shape follows MPI-491's finding: either route the prebake through the Xet-native path (huggingface_hub is now in wrapper/requirements.txt) or stage the weights to R2 like the other 101 deps - RIFE has no licence bar on redistribution, unlike H3. Lives in c:/AI/Mpi/mpi-ci/cubric-vision-pod/Dockerfile.
